notes.title: Professor Why™ new game will be released soon!
notes.notes:
Hey you!

Thank you for playing our game Professor Why™ Chemistry 1, we hope that you've enjoyed discovering an exciting world of Chemistry! Before we release part 2, we are proud to announce our new game's premiere which is planned for the end of November 2015. 

Our newest product will have brand new features and we promise you great fun while playing it! There is much more humor, much more action, much more to discover!

If you want to keep up to date, visit our blog at: http://blog.professor-why.com
We've just published the story which is behind our newest title - come and read it yourself! :)
